note: Authored, deterministic id-alias map that reunites fragmented logged history at READ time only. Each key is a retired/session-only exercise id whose logged sets belong to the SAME real movement as `target` (a current plan exercise id). At display time (progress, PB, history, the 'Previous' column, hub PRs) sets under a source id are counted as the target's. Logs are NEVER rewritten — this is a pure read-time union, and removing an entry instantly un-merges it. Built by hand from the 2026-08-13 export audit (see EXERCISE-DATA-AUDIT.md F1); never fuzzy-matched at runtime. Only same-movement, load-type-compatible merges are included. Deliberately EXCLUDED because they are different movements or would mix incomparable loads: Lat Pulldown / 'Pull Down' history (weighted pulldown ≠ bodyweight Pull-up), Incline Barbell Bench (≠ Incline Dumbbell Press), Tricep Extension (≠ Tricep Pushdown), Dumbbell Shoulder Press (≠ Barbell Overhead Press), Rear Delt Fly (≠ Band Pull-Apart), and 'Basic Squat' (ambiguous data). confidence: high | medium.
